metadata.name: LLM (generic)
metadata.summary: Generic LLM step node for Greentic flows
metadata.description: Ships the canonical generic `llm` nodeType — a fallback for prompt-driven AI steps that aren't pinned to a specific provider. Provider-specific extensions (greentic.llm-openai and friends) ship richer nodeTypes that implement the actual completion call; this generic node is a placeholder the planner can target when the provider is unknown or pluggable. Pure metadata extension: no WASM logic, only the descriptor + JSON Schema the designer needs to render the inspector form.

nodeTypes.label: LLM
nodeTypes.config_schema: {"type":"object","required":["model"],"properties":{"model":{"type":"string","description":"Model id (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5, gpt-4o, llama3:8b)","default":"claude-haiku-4-5","examples":["claude-haiku-4-5","gpt-4o","gpt-4o-mini","llama3:8b"]},"system":{"type":"string","description":"System prompt","format":"textarea"},"temperature":{"type":"number","description":"Sampling temperature. 0 is deterministic, higher values increase diversity. Common range 0–2 depending on the provider; check your model's docs for valid bounds. Leave unset to use the provider default."},"max_tokens":{"type":"integer","description":"Maximum number of tokens to generate","minimum":1}}}
